title: Record
description: A record as a reader checks it at step 3 of a read (record_format.md section 1 item 2): the envelope, and the body's structure as far as schema 0.1 knows it. Open: members and tokens it does not know pass, and it never applies the shape of a value field, a form or a section's specimen. Its $defs hold those shapes as step 8 checks them (read_side_contract.md section 3), opened alike, without the members a read does not check.

record_type.description: record_format.md section 3. An interface record's body is specified in a later minor version.

licence.description: The licence of the values, an SPDX expression; quoted evidence is never covered by it (record_format.md section 2).

sections.description: The sections of schema 0.1, every one optional (record_format.md section 4.1).

fields.description: A field's name to its value field.
A field's name to its value field.
A field's name to its value field.
A field's name to its value field.

extensions.description: A registered namespace to its sections; a reader ignores what it holds (record_format.md section 4 item 4).

base.description: The one material an overlay replaces fields of (record_format.md section 4.4 item 2).

model.description: A consumer's model, by name and version; the version is the consumer's, not bound by record_format.md section 8.

replaces.description: <section>.<field> to the whole value field that replaces the base's (record_format.md section 4.4 item 2).

value_field.description: A value field of one form, or the alternatives of one (record_format.md section 5). A reader checks it only when it reads the field.

form_field.description: A value field of one form; the form token decides which (record_format.md sections 5 and 6).

alternatives.description: Every alternative found, each complete, in stored order and none the default; nothing beside them (record_format.md section 5).

field_members.description: The members of a value field that do not depend on its form (record_format.md section 5), with the rules that join them to the form: a fit record where the origin is fitted or the extraction a fit (provenance.md section 3), a search where the statistics represent a spread across sources, and a recipe where the form's member is withheld (provenance.md sections 2 and 7).

constant_field.description: A constant: one number, whose range is its conditions (record_format.md section 6).

table_field.description: A table (record_format.md section 6). Its member is a placeholder until its shape is written.

power_law_field.description: A power law (record_format.md section 6). Its member is a placeholder until its shape is written.

interval_field.description: An interval: bounds with their basis, known only as bounds (record_format.md section 6).

parameter_set_field.description: A model parameter set (model_families.md). Its member is a placeholder until its shape is written.

reference_data_field.description: Reference data (fits_and_reference_data.md section 1), whose statistics may not apply. Its member is a placeholder until its shape is written.

evidence_field.description: Biocompatibility evidence: a list of test reports, never a status, under no condition and with no statistics (record_format.md section 4.3).

conditions.description: No condition: a registered one here breaks the field's shape.

unit.description: A unit code, compared with the registered unit at step 9 alone (record_format.md section 4.2), or a status object.

interval.description: lower <= upper where both are numbers, and at most one holds none (record_format.md section 6).

composition.description: At least one component, none twice; stated_sum is the sum the source gives, never normalised (record_format.md section 6).

composition_component.description: A component, element:<symbol>, its fraction from 0 to 1, and optionally its own statistics block.

evidence_entry.description: A test report (record_format.md section 4.3). Each member but provenance may hold a status object other than withheld.

withheld_evidence_entry.description: A test report from a reference-only source: withheld whole, its provenance kept and carrying the recipe (record_format.md section 4.3 item 2, provenance.md section 7 item 2).

report_text.description: The source's words, until the member's tokens are listed (record_format.md section 4.3).

standard.description: The standard and part a test followed, and its year, a whole number.

conditions.description: The conditions the value was measured at, by name (provenance.md section 6.1): a token condition holds a token of its own row's list, and a numeric one's registered unit is compared at step 9.

based.description: Where a condition or a specimen fact comes from: stated, or inferred with the text it was inferred from (provenance.md section 6).

numeric_condition.description: A value or a range [lo, hi], lo not above hi, in the condition's registered unit; optionally the source's plus or minus and whether it was set or measured (provenance.md section 6.1 items 1, 6 and 7).

condition_density_kind.description: The token condition density_kind: a token of its row (provenance.md section 6.1 item 1); it registers no unit.

condition_specimen_shape.description: The token condition specimen_shape: a token of its row (provenance.md section 6.1 item 1); it registers no unit.

condition_measurement_geometry.description: The token condition measurement_geometry: a token of its row (provenance.md section 6.1 item 1); it registers no unit.

condition_test_method.description: The token condition test_method: a token of its row (provenance.md section 6.1 item 1); it registers no unit.

plus_minus.description: The plus or minus a source states (provenance.md section 6.1 item 6): at most one entry of each kind, and one of unstated kind alone.

specimen.description: Specimen facts, by name (provenance.md section 6.2); a field's override its section's, fact by fact.

disease_and_treatment_state.description: The state, and which disease or treatment.

preservation.description: The preservation, with a text required for other.

donor_age.description: A value or a range [lo, hi], in seconds.

mimics.description: What a phantom or a substitute was made to mimic, as its maker states it: its basis is stated, never inferred, so it has no inferred_from.

supply_form.description: A manufactured material as supplied, a coupon made or cut for the test, or a finished component tested as a specimen of its material.

lot.description: The lot or batch, as the source names it.

field_statistics.description: A statistics block, withheld in a reference-only value (uncertainty.md section 1).

statistics_block.description: uncertainty.md section 1: every member present, population_level, n_sources and precision_conditions exactly where represents calls for them.

count.description: A whole number, not negative, or a status object.

population_level.description: The level a population spread is taken over, and the level it is taken within (uncertainty.md section 1 rule 10).

uncertainty.description: A relative or expanded uncertainty, as stored (uncertainty.md section 1): at least one of coverage_factor and coverage_probability a number, dof a number exactly where distribution is student_t, and precision_conditions exactly where represents is measurement. value is in unit 1 in a relative one, and in the field's unit in an expanded one.

provenance.description: provenance.md section 2. A read checks origin, source and derivation; the other members are the record checks'.

source.description: The source registry's key, the document read and the place in it. A read checks only key, which a result returns.

derivation.description: A derived value's method, its inputs as pinned references, its assumptions, the inputs' specimen facts, and whether the inputs' conditions differ (provenance.md section 5).

input_specimen.description: An input's specimen facts, input being its index in inputs.

pinned_record.description: A record by its id and version, pinned by its content hash.

status_object.description: A member's status where it has no ordinary value (provenance.md section 1).

status_withheld.description: A status object holding withheld: a reference-only value (provenance.md section 7).

status_unstated_or_not_applicable.description: A status object holding unstated or not_applicable.

status_withheld_or_not_applicable.description: A status object holding withheld or not_applicable.

status_not_withheld.description: A status object holding any token but withheld, which an evidence entry holds only whole.
